Five disciplines, one crew, no handoffs.

About A1 Constructions

A family construction business, run the way you'd build your own home.

A1 Constructions is a full-service construction company handling homes, villas, interiors, exteriors and swimming pools — led personally by Mushtaq Gangrekar and a small crew of experienced site engineers and craftsmen.

We stay on-site through every stage, from the first excavation to the final coat of paint, so nothing gets lost in translation between the plan and what actually gets built.

01

Transparent costing

Clear, itemised quotes with no hidden charges added later.

02

Hands-on supervision

A dedicated engineer on-site through every stage of the build.

03

Materials that last

Sourced for coastal weather, not just the lowest bid.

How we work

From first conversation to handing you the keys.

01

Consult & Site Visit

We walk the plot with you, understand the brief and budget, and give you a realistic first estimate.

02

Design & Approvals

Structural planning, layouts and the paperwork needed to get building permissions sorted.

03

Build

Foundation to finish — structure, exteriors, interiors and pools built and supervised in-house.

04

Handover

A final walkthrough together, snag list cleared, and the keys handed over.
